verdict.rationale: The s.jina.ai search endpoint runs the web search, fetches the top 5 results, and applies r.jina.ai to each URL, so one call returns LLM-friendly full content rather than links and snippets. The docs also show query-time site filtering. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the search endpoint returns full content, and documented control over the number of results beyond the fixed top 5.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets

citations.quote: Behind the scenes, Reader searches the web, fetches the top 5 results, visits each URL, and applies `r.jina.ai` to it.
It searches the web for a given query with `https://s.jina.ai/your+query`.
